topics.title: Role of Business in the Development of the Economy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how indigenous instruments such as hundi and chitties helped the transfer of money for trade.
Describe the trade centres, exports and favourable balance of trade that made ancient India prosperous.
Explain how India's economy changed under British rule, after independence and with the reforms of 1991.
Distinguish economic activities from non-economic activities by their motive.
Identify the characteristics that distinguish a business activity from other activities.

topics.title: Comparison of Business, Profession and Employment

concepts.learning_objective: Compare business, profession and employment on mode of establishment, qualification and reward.
Compare business, profession and employment on capital, risk and transfer of interest.
Classify extractive and genetic industries as primary industries with examples.
Classify manufacturing (analytical, synthetical, processing, assembling) and construction industries.
Explain why tertiary industries provide support services and form part of commerce.

topics.title: Commerce, Trade and Auxiliaries to Trade

concepts.learning_objective: Relate each activity of commerce to the hindrance of persons, place, time, risk, finance or information it removes.
Explain the role of transport, banking, insurance, warehousing, advertising and public relations in trade.
Explain why profit is an essential but not the only objective of business.
Identify the multiple objectives of business such as market standing, innovation, productivity and social responsibility.
Distinguish speculative risks from pure risks with examples.
Explain the nature of business risks, including profit as the reward for risk taking.
Classify the causes of business risks into natural, human, economic and other causes.
Explain the meaning of entrepreneurship and its role in the economic development of a nation.
Identify the basic factors an entrepreneur must consider while starting a business.
